payload.summary: Owner decision: ledger-eligible authority entry for Australian Prescriber
payload.detail: The Australian Prescriber movement-disorders article is fully established (1 April 2019, Aust Prescr 2019;42:56-61, doi 10.18773/austprescr.2019.014) and is already cited by the published dictionary for the extrapyramidal side-effect terms. It cannot enter the acquisition ledger because src/lib/source-authority-registry.ts registers australian-prescriber with catalogueIdentityOnly true, and the acquisition gate warns that changing that alters retrieval selection. The date work is banked in src/data/dictionary-source-dispositions.json; only the governance decision remains.
